note: Note: MAE/RMSE are in raw currency units, and this dataset spans categories from ~$5 (Grocery) to ~$800+ (Electronics) base prices, so absolute error is naturally larger than a single-category dataset would produce -- MAPE and R^2 are the more meaningful cross-category metrics here. R^2 in the ~75-85% range is the explicit target for this project (see README), not a maximum achievable ceiling to push past.
